breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J in the torsional strain energy formula U = ∫T²/(2GJ)dx, but it still includes a separate step to 'Calculate the moment of inertia I using the formula I = π d^4/64,' which is not present in the ground truth and perpetuates the original error by keeping I = πd⁴/64 as a relevant calculation in a pure torsion problem. The ground truth makes no mention of I whatsoever.
